Name: Motion table
Description: One 6-byte entry per motion kind (entry n = motion n; 0x000-0x210 common, 0x211+ the fighter's own). The count must equal the fighter's motion count (motion.mtable).
Evidence: loader 0x02EA9008 copies it into the motion table; docs/params/fighter_files.md section 4

Name: Loop flag
Description: Non-zero sets bit 0x80 of the motion entry flags (+6); 0 on looping motions (docs/params/fighter_files.md); community: Animation Loop

Name: Transition / blend frames
Description: Copied to the motion entry +4 (community: transition frame)

Name: Interrupt frame
Description: Frame compared with the current motion frame (community: interrupt frame)
Evidence: 0x02E24D4C, 0x02E299B0, 0x02E2DFEC (lbz +2, converted to float, compared with the frame)

Name: Intangibility start
Description: Community: intangibility start frame

Name: Intangibility end
Description: Community: intangibility end frame

Name: Disable hitlag animation
Description: Community: disable hitlag animation

Name: Idle (Wait) animation odds
Description: Entries (u32 subaction/motion ID, u32 odds); last entry 0xFFFFFFFF 0xFFFFFFFF ends the list

Name: Crouch idle animation odds
Description: Same layout as group 2

Name: Ground box (ECB) bones
Description: u32 bone ID, f32 x y z: the ground box is the bounding box of these points (min 4 x 4)

Name: Hurtboxes
Description: f32 x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2, f32 radius, u32 bone, part, height, unk, pool (0x30 bytes); count free

Name: Three u32 values
Description: Unknown. 3 entries everywhere; e.g. Mario 1 0 6, Marth 2 0 8, Captain Falcon 0 1 7, Kirby 0 0 0. Entry 0 is read by 0x02BFBD04 for the fighter found through a linked object (resolved by ID 0x50000000) and by Meta Knight's code (0x02F25150, entry 1)

Name: Ledge-grab boxes
Description: f32 x y x2 y2 (sheet) / x y w h (vl_shapes); entry 0 normal, 1 tumble, extra entries for tethers

Name: Final Smash aura bones
Description: u32 bone, f32 x y height width (community)

Name: Attach points (item placement)
Description: u32 bone, f32 x y z, f32 rot x y z; kept as joint IDs 10000+n

Name: Attach points (gooey bomb / pikmin placement)
Description: same layout; joint IDs 11000+n; usually one per hurtbox bone

Name: Unknown 7-float entries
Description: 2 (sometimes 3 or 16) entries of 7 floats: mirrored X (-x / +x), y, z, three angles?, a size (e.g. Kirby -0.9 -0.2 -0.2 0 0 0 1 / 0.9 ...); entry fields read by 0x02E01CD4 (+0x20/+0x24/+0x28 of the entry block)

Name: Special-move param modifiers
Description: (u32 param ID of category 5-8 or a weapon's 2, f32 ?, f32 multiplier, f32 ?, f32 ?, f32 ?): the specials params that a stat boost scales (community: Smash Tour "Special" stat). Weapons have the same kind of list in their own vl member (e.g. Kirby g24 for Final Cutter, served by the weapon descriptor +0x24)
Evidence: community sheet; 0x031AA6EC (Final Cutter descriptor returns Kirby vl+0x1A8)

Name: Neutral special
Description: 4 entries (custom slots 0-2 + an extra slot 3); the entry of the fighter's slot (instance int 0x10000048) is copied into WorkModule category 5 when the fighter is set up: ID 0x05000000+i (float) / 0x15000000+i (int) = word i
Evidence: 0x02F1BF88 / 0x02F1C19C; slot values set at 0x02E12B94 (player's custom choice, >= 3 -> 0; kinds 0x33-0x3C always 0)

Name: Side special
Description: Same with slot int 0x10000049 -> category 6 (0x06000000 / 0x16000000)

Name: Up special
Description: Same with slot int 0x1000004A -> category 7 (0x07000000 / 0x17000000)

Name: Down special
Description: Same with slot int 0x1000004B -> category 8 (0x08000000 / 0x18000000)

Name: Category 4 block
Description: The struct (or single value) at vl+0x140, right after group 16's entries (no group marker of its own). Copied into WorkModule category 4 (0x04000000+i / 0x14000000+i). Often Final Smash params; size per kind: table 0x1012F638

Name: Fighter-specific members
Description: Vectors, structs and scalars that only the fighter's own native code reads (directly from the vl struct), or weapon (article) param blocks: the weapon descriptor's get_param (+0x18) returns entry [custom slot] and it becomes the weapon's WorkModule category 2 (0x02000000+i / 0x12000000+i)
Evidence: e.g. 0x02B03F3C (Kirby star missile), 0x031AA6B0 (Final Cutter); 194 such accessors mapped (vl_schema.json role weapon)
